scope: Resident 0.1.5 fixed-Lab native install/launch/cooperative-exit qualified on one firmware 3.65 Vita: four cycles across two native builds; arbitrary applications and interruption testing remain separate gates.

host_validation.scope: Actual host C and stdio MCP with local adapters/simulated SDK effects; no hardware acceptance

review_fixes: Strict PC schema aligned to actual C Lab status and exit ACK fields.
Only installation receipts claim installed_verified; launch receipts survive strict restart recovery.
Read-only reconciliation recovers newer fsynced JSONL intents when report.json is stale.
Promoter working path is below 128 bytes and uses a verified separate copy; original stage retained.

device_staging.activation: normal boot operator-confirmed; exact native build verified

hardware_lifecycle.promoter_availability_and_header_accepta: passed for both recorded fixed-Lab packages only
hardware_lifecycle.native_install_and_installed_hashes: passed: four cycles, all eight installed hashes each cycle
hardware_lifecycle.interrupted_native_operation_durability: host tested; not power-cut qualified on hardware

prior_hardware_attempt.cause: unverified; shorter workspace is an isolated diagnostic correction, not an error-code mapping

limits: Only lifecycle_lab / VMCP00001; accepted DevLoop installation is unchanged.
Conservative idle_shell_only guard; display ownership and protected UI are not attested.
One plan runs 1..3 cycles of the same exact candidate; build changed source then make a new plan.
At most 8 MiB per file, 16 MiB total, 32 stages and 64 operations per Resident build.
Retained uncertain effects block mutation and are never replayed; no automatic rollback, uninstall, garbage collection or ownership migration.
No Control/kernel helper, input, capture, keep-awake or boot-configuration changes in the native runner.
Native operation freshness is at most five seconds through preparation despite a receipt TTL up to thirty seconds; larger package behavior is unqualified.

public_catalog.registered_connection_refresh: pending; earlier 33-tool registered proof belongs to installed 0.1.4

github_ci.policy: Require the Host validation check on the exact pull-request head. Its report and logs are separate from the local and hardware records here.

privacy.public: PC and Vita source, protocols, documentation and sanitized validation
privacy.private: iPhone source, Swift/Xcode/signing/build/handoff material, administrator credentials and raw device journals
